extraction: Verbatim transcription of the published LaTeX table. No unit conversion, no derivation, no cross-table join.
note: Martinsson+2013 DiskMass Survey VI (A&A 557 A130), Table 6: exponential fits to the sigma_LOS and sigma_z radial profiles. sigma_z_0 is the CENTRAL vertical stellar velocity dispersion of the exponential fit, NOT a radially resolved profile. h_sigma_z is the e-folding scale length of that fit, in ARCSEC.
